the synthesis of silver nanoparticles using the leaf extract of Dodonea viscosa is simple, eco-friendly, and effective for the synthesis of silver nano structures with different morphologies and sizes.
the synthesis of silver nanoparticles with different shapes and size using different solvents from the same plant material is possible.
